SOC

Kiểm soát sự cố

The actions taken to limit the impact of a security incident by isolating affected systems, preventing lateral movement, and preserving evidence for investigation.

Definition

The actions taken to limit the impact of a security incident by isolating affected systems, preventing lateral movement, and preserving evidence for investigation.

Operational example

Incident containment strategies may involve disconnecting compromised hosts from the network to prevent threat propagation.
